read_text: Once upon a time, in a lush forest, a tortoise named Toto lived a slow and steady life. One day, Toto decided to participate in a race with the other animals. Everyone laughed at him, but Toto didn't mind. He trained hard every day, moving steadily towards the finish line. On the race day, while all the other competitors ran fast, Toto moved slowly but surely. To the surprise of everyone, he crossed the finish line first. From that day on, all the animals respected Toto and his wise words, 'Slow and steady wins the race.'

read_text: Washing your hands is an important part of hygiene. It helps to prevent the spread of germs and keeps you healthy. You should always wash your hands before eating, after using the bathroom, and after blowing your nose, coughing, or sneezing. Use soap and water to wash your hands thoroughly. Scrub for at least 20 seconds and make sure to get the backs of your hands, between your fingers, and under your nails. Rinse well and dry your hands with a clean towel or air dryer. Washing your hands is a simple but important thing you can do to keep yourself healthy.
